reason: judged the change against the issue: 2 requirement(s) not met or not sure

unmet: LOOP-1: `_cycle_iter_dispatch` has no code to skip cycle members already marked complete in the interrupted iteration; it dispatches all members in `_CYCLE_STAGES[]` unconditionally, so CMBR-1 test fails (`_CMBR1_BUILD_DISPATCHED=1`, expected 0) — "Inside a loop (e.g. build → test), a run interrupted mid-round resumes at the interrupted stage of that round."

GUAR-2: The FRSH-2 third assertion added in this DIFF asserts `_frsh2_cycled_starts==1`, but the `cycled` member (role: builder) fails plugin resolution before `stage.start` is emitted at runner.sh:3213, so the assertion is unreachable in this environment and cannot pass regardless of whether the `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` guard exists. The test tagged `[#1805/FRSH-2]` fails, leaving GUAR-2 without a passing test — "A **new** run of the same issue still never skips a stage because of an earlier run's output (ADR-050 §6). This is a guard."
